text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While having a meeting with T.M. Opera O—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Trainer.
It seems yesterday's excitement still lingers.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
On the way back, I found myself embraced by the raindrops.
I indulged in a brief frolic with them before reaching the dorms.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The stage woven by the pouring rain and myself
is fantastical and passionate...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, even now,
this dizzying fever just won't fade!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to show Trainer-kun too!
Ah-hah-hah-hah-hah—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was clear that she had caught a cold,
so T.M. Opera O was sent home to rest.
